div.div: 7 انجذّ It became cut, or cut off: (S, L, Msb, K:) or cut off utterly: or cut off utterly and quickly: and in like manner, ↓ تجذّذ [said of a number of things, or used in a frequentative or an intensive sense; being quasi-pass. of 2]. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
